{{Quote|As no doubt members of the Council are aware, Apsolon is a center of the high-tech industry.|[[Tahl]] addressing the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Ties That Bind">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Ties That Bind]]''</ref>}}
'''Apsolon''', later renamed '''New Apsolon''', was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], it was a part of the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was renamed when a bloodless revolution led by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Tahl]] overthrew the totalitarian [[Absolutes]] and replaced their government with democracy. In a failed coup, the Absolutes attempted to regain power [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]].

The planet was a member of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

New Apsolon was split into two groups: the [[Workers]], people of low importance, and the [[Civilized]], people of higher importance. The only worker ever known to be the leader of the planet was [[Ewane]].

The planet sat on the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|Ootmian Pabol]].
